name: Positioning multi-tenancy at the DATA plane -- make 'nobody else' TRUE for the Positioning page by serving it firm-scoped, so Cottonwood's Satellites are withheld as BYTES and not merely hidden as PIXELS, over a substrate that is mid-migration and must not be coupled to
description: Andrew-direct 2026-08-27 ~18:5xZ at the 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Z terminal (verbatim record: org/tier1_exec/1.0.0_SA_CTO/deliverables/ANDREW_DIRECT_20260827_1855Z_POSITIONING_MULTITENANT_PATTERNS.md @dc18f5a855): 'we have to sort out multi-tenant functionality for the Positioning page. The Satellites functionality is something specific to Cottonwood, which means it should be available on Cottonwood's page, but nobody else. Of course that does mean that Opal needs to be able to see it, so the patterns that govern these things need to be deeply analyzed and an implementation spec designed and rigorously validated for potential breakages.' THE FORK IN THAT SENTENCE -- is 'nobody else' a VISIBILITY statement or an ACCESS statement -- was carried to him on /open-calls and SETTLED ~19:4xZ, 'recs approved' = (b) ACCESS (record @5f60dd944a). CONSEQUENCE, and it is his ruling flowing through this seat's own stated consequence rather than a new gate: the shipped client-side gate (modesFor(firm), ETFS_SATELLITES TO-3/TO-4) is NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT -- it hides the pill and refuses the persisted-toggle tamper, but satellites are ARITHMETIC OVER positioning_data.json, served on api/general/ to every authenticated user of every firm, so the bytes reach everyone regardless. The endpoint DOES authenticate (401 bare, a DISTINCT 401 invalid), so the missing control is FIRM-DISCRIMINATION, not AUTHENTICATION. MEASURED AT REGISTRATION -- nearly every piece already exists and this is WIRING ON EXISTING INFRASTRUCTURE, not new infrastructure: Cottonwood identity + page allowlist EXIST (AUTH_COTTON COMPLETE 2026-04-29, firmAccess.ts 'cottonwood' includes /positioning) but AUTH_COTTON was explicitly 'identity-and-allowlist only, NO DATA PIPELINE'; a firm-scoped serving plane EXISTS (/api/scoped/, 10 files, AdvisorIntelligence the worked example); a firm-keyed CDN cache policy EXISTS (opal_scoped_advisor_by_firm, keyed on firm query string + X-Firm-Id header, JWT-INJECTED NOT REQUEST-DERIVED -- the property that makes the structure real rather than decorative); the React-Query firmOverride convention EXISTS on 4+ keys. WHAT IS ABSENT IS EXACTLY ONE THING: Positioning served scoped -- models and etfs are both on /api/general/ and NO Positioning query key carries a firm. ANDREW-DIRECT ~19:5xZ, THE SUBSTRATE, three corrections in one exchange (verbatim, PRD s.2a): 'No that is an old bucket' / 'we use opal-data-assets for prety much all data needs' / 'the opal-data-cot opal-data-inf opal-data-bd wll be deprecated' / and then, correcting this seat's OVER-correction, 'eventually there will be new firm specific buckets set up for various thing, e.g. opal-data-49financial opal-data-inflection opal-data-cottonwood (notice they are not abbreviated), but we have not gotten to this yet.' THE REGISTERING SEAT'S ERROR, RECORDED BECAUSE IT IS THE CLASS OF ERROR THIS SEAT SPENT THE SESSION CORRECTING IN OTHERS: it read FIRM_DATA_BUCKETS out of a PYTHON LITERAL in derive_stitch.py and reported 'Cottonwood data bucket EXISTS' -- a list in a source file is a claim about what its author believed, and even the live list-buckets run afterward shows only that a bucket EXISTS, never that it is CURRENT. Existence and currency are different properties and one was read off the other. Caught PRE-COMMIT by Andrew; nothing propagated. MEASURED LIVE (s3api) BECAUSE HIS SENTENCE AND THE WORLD DIFFER IN ONE PLACE THAT MATTERS: opal-data-assets EXISTS 2026-07-14; opal-data-cot/inf/bd EXIST (2026-06-08 / 2026-04-21 / 2026-01-09, abbreviated, deprecating); opal-data-49financial EXISTS 2026-08-19 -- THE MIGRATION HAS ALREADY BEGUN -- while opal-data-inflection and opal-data-cottonwood are ABSENT. His 'we have not gotten to this yet' is true of the PROGRAMME; one of the three new-style buckets is nonetheless already provisioned, and a decomp reading only the sentence would plan three creations and find one done. THE DESIGN CONSEQUENCE, AND IT IS THE LOAD-BEARING LINE OF THE WHOLE PRD: THE SUBSTRATE IS A MOVING TARGET, SO THE DESIGN MUST NOT COUPLE TO ITS CURRENT SHAPE -- not to consolidated opal-data-assets and not to per-firm buckets either; the firm->location resolution belongs behind ONE NAMED INDIRECTION that can be re-pointed when the new buckets land, without touching the serving or client layers. A design that hard-codes today's substrate must be rewritten mid-migration. HIS THREE RULINGS SEPARATE AND THIS SEAT HAD FLATTENED THEM: firm-scoped SERVING (api/scoped/, firm in the CDN cache key, X-Firm-Id JWT-injected) STILL GOVERNS; WHERE THE BYTES LIVE is IN FLIGHT. ADVI_FIRMSEP therefore remains the right precedent for the ACCESS-CONTROL limb and the WRONG precedent for the STORAGE limb (its FIRM_BUCKET_MAP over abbreviated buckets is mid-replacement and must not be copied as-is). BLAST RADIUS IS WIDER THAN THE PAGE HE NAMED: positioning_data.json is consumed by ATTRIBUTION and ModelPortfolioModal, rollbackInvalidation.ts:58 HARDCODES the query key, and all four partner firms reach /positioning -- so either every firm gets a scoped artifact or three firms lose the page, and Attribution was never in scope of his sentence and now is.

blocking: ANDREW-DIRECT ~22:1xZ SETTLED THE PROJECT'S CENTRAL DESIGN FORK, VERBATIM: 'I think it is better to just do a scoped api path for the satellites, that way we dont have to mess with the rest of the plumbing of the page and it is inobtrusive + if we decide later that it makes more sense to just handle this elsewhere, then doing so is not a massive effort. also agreed on call 2'. Record: org/tier1_exec/1.0.0_SA_CTO/deliverables/ANDREW_DIRECT_20260827_2215Z_SCOPED_PATH_FOR_SATELLITES_ONLY.md. BRANCH (a): a NEW firm-scoped API path carries the SATELLITES payload; positioning_data.json, MODELS and ETFS are UNTOUCHED and stay general. He priced REVERSIBILITY as the selection criterion -- not which design is most correct today but which is cheapest to be wrong about. THE CAVEAT THIS SEAT ATTACHED (that (a) puts Satellites on a different footing from the other two modes, against his ~21:3xZ forked-routes rule) WAS IN FRONT OF HIM AND HE RULED PAST IT -- that is a decision and must not be re-litigated. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE CERTIFIED CELLS, 2.0.0_SA_COO~Z to amend and 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z to certify: PT-a-1's SUBJECT is now wrong ('Positioning's artifact is served through /api/scoped/') -- the artifact does not move, a new Satellites path is created beside it; its ORACLE survives unchanged. PT-a-2 (X-Firm-Id JWT-injected) and PT-a-3 (firm in the CDN cache key) are UNAFFECTED and bind HARDER, since the new path becomes the only firm-discriminated surface. THE ORDERING CONSTRAINT SURVIVES AND DID NOT COME FROM THE UNIFORMITY RULE: the scoped path must exist BEFORE OR WITH the Satellites payload, never after -- positioning_data.json is measured OPAL-COMMON (five Opal models, benchmarks, segments), so SATELLITES IS THE FIRST FIRM-SPECIFIC PAYLOAD AND THEREFORE IS THE TRIGGER. SATELLITE REGISTRY MAINTAINER: ⛔ DISSOLVED, NOT ANSWERED, by ANDREW-DIRECT ~22:5xZ @efa437d8ef -- 'This shouldnt be handdrawn at all, it should simply be "Does it say Opal Satellite in the name? Add it and track henceforth if so. If an Opal Satellite disappears from daily pulls, now it is no longer tracked."' MEMBERSHIP IS A PREDICATE OVER THE DAILY PULLS, so there is nothing to maintain and the PREDICATE IS THE MAINTAINER. This retires the shipping condition entirely rather than filling it. TO-2's nine hardcoded rows become the VALIDATION FIXTURE for the predicate, not the source of truth -- 0.0.0_AB_MSTR~Z measured the anchored regex already in the file reproducing that hand list 9/9 with ZERO false admits on the 65-row roster, ⛔ BUT THAT 9/9 IS NOT EVIDENCE FOR THE ANCHORING AND THIS SEAT'S SENTENCE CLAIMING IT WAS IS WITHDRAWN: 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z measured the RIVAL predicate on the same 65-row fixture and a BARE SUBSTRING CHECK ADMITS THE IDENTICAL 9 ROWS -- the roster contains no row the two would classify differently, and Andrew's named blend is NOT among the 65. So the 9/9 establishes NO FALSE NEGATIVES and is structurally incapable of establishing the anchoring; the control cannot fail over its own input. CONSEQUENCE: THE ANCHORING CANNOT BE VALIDATED AGAINST LIVE DATA AND THE NEGATIVE CONTROL MUST BE SYNTHETIC -- a fabricated blend-form row the anchored predicate MUST refuse and the naive one WOULD admit. His 'they may do some stupid shit like that again' makes the adversary a FUTURE input, so its absence today is the expected state, not a gap. NAMED HARD CASE, a spec constraint and not a caveat: an SMA that is a BLEND of an Opal satellite and something else must NOT admit ('if it says opal satellite with some other shit that is not acceptable'), he expects recurrence, and that blend is the required NEGATIVE CONTROL on the predicate. AND THIS SEAT'S CONDUCT IS RECORDED: I refused twice to name a maintainer BY INFERENCE (correct, SAT-inv-2) and routed it as sovereign (correct), but NEVER ASKED WHETHER A MAINTAINER SHOULD EXIST AT ALL. A well-formed refusal to answer a malformed question leaves the malformation in place. CLOSED: the CLAUDE.md NEVER-rule re-point (his 'yes approve all recs', executed @69dffcd5d4, broadcast to eight seats). NO OPEN SOVEREIGN CALL REMAINS ON THIS PROJECT.
